item: The engine's failure lines are scrubbed where the P0 verify check copies them, an empty secret matches nothing in cut text, and the passphrase guard's reach is stated exactly
key_paths: src/monitoring/p0_validation.py; src/monitoring/secret_scrub.py; tests/test_p0_validation.py; tests/test_secret_scrub.py; docs/CHANGES.md; docs/ledger/LESSONS.md
summary: The coordinator's delta check of #1312 (verdict: nits) found one route of the shape of the passphrase finding that no handler-based test reaches (F2): verify_stream_backup returns its failure lines as data (problems), a decrypt failure's line carries the exception's own words, and the verify check copies the list into its measurements (the P0 file the debug bundle carries) and its reason (a release run's state and report). Every message the engine raises there is a literal today, so nothing leaked; the lines are now scrubbed line by line where the check copies them, never the verdict or the check's own words around them (the run puts no minimum on a passphrase's length). Tests: a distinctive passphrase is absent from the result and the written file with the engine's own list left unedited, and a passphrase of pass or fail leaves the verdict and the lead of the reason alone; five mutations are each caught. F3: _scrub_cut_text with an empty secret raised empty separator since the rewrite and returns the text again (unreachable through scrub_file, which returns earlier), one assertion and one mutation. F1: the ledger said the static test makes a fifth handler impossible to add unseen; it holds the handlers of the functions of p0_validation.py that take a parameter named passphrase, and LESSONS, the shipped log and the shipped row now say so, with the three things outside it (the engine's lines handed back as data, a secret under another name or through an object, a helper that reads the exception for itself). Lesson: LESSONS.md, the entry on the passphrase in what the P0 phase catches.
